validation.scope: Final schema 2.14 implementation freshly analyzes the current real ProGraph source and validates default semantic authority in a separate disposable index. An independent full bulk reference validates the complete new code-architecture payload. Source LOC excludes dependencies and counts the selected code files only.

cycleOracle.scope: Explicit offline cycle preparation on the final-runtime freshly analyzed ProGraph index, compared with complete raw-graph bulk results across all five scopes and three confidence tiers. Native facts, report and owned compatibility payloads remain unchanged.

prepared.ordering: stable relationship identity; DFS back-edge semantics

cycleOracle.methodology: The original iterative DFS back-edge algorithm runs on stable edge-ID order. These are representative cycle paths, not an exhaustive cycle or SCC enumeration. Original insertion-order samples may differ; the complete new path list must exactly equal the independent stable-order bulk reference. Concurrent test execution disqualifies timing/RSS claims.

limits: Concurrent with complete actual-provider tests: elapsed/RSS fields are observations, not performance qualification. TypeScript compiler and syntax fallback only for this repository; native-provider qualification is independent. Read-only database byte comparison precedes explicit cycle preparation, which changes only offline query caches; cycle proof checks native/owned/report identities unchanged. Captured before adding this evidence to the repository; later docs changes can make the temporary self index stale.
